definitions.gloss: rebuilding; reconstruction; tearing down and building anew
definitions.explanation: The act of demolishing an existing structure and constructing a new one in its place. Different from renovation (リフォーム), which preserves the basic structure.

examples.english: We decided to rebuild the house.

examples.japanese: ⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{建|た}て{替|か}え⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The apartment building reconstruction work has begun.

examples.japanese: ⟦{老朽化|ろうきゅうか}→老朽化：07646_roukyuuka⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{校舎|こうしゃ}→校舎：02801_kousha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{建|た}て{替|か}え⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{数年|すうねん}→数年：28206_suunen⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦{見込|みこ}み→見込み：06872_mikomi⟧だ。
examples.english: The rebuilding of the deteriorated school building is expected to take several years.

notes:
The noun form of {建|た}て{替|か}える (to rebuild). Refers specifically to demolishing and rebuilding from scratch, not mere repair or renovation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {建|た}て{替|か}え⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧ — rebuilding construction
- {建|た}て{替|か}え⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧ — rebuilding costs
- {建|た}て{替|か}え⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧ — rebuilding plan
- {建|た}て{替|か}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{検討|けんとう}する→検討する：17455_kentousuru⟧ — to consider rebuilding

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦リフォーム→リフォーム：08821_rifoomu⟧ — renovation; remodeling (preserves the basic structure)
- ⟦{改築|かいちく}→改築：06224_kaichiku⟧ — rebuilding; structural alteration (can be partial)
- ⟦{新築|しんちく}→新築：06567_shinchiku⟧ — new construction; building from scratch on a new or cleared site
- ⟦{修繕|しゅうぜん}→修繕：06569_shuuzen⟧ — repair; maintenance (fixes problems without replacing the whole structure)

NOTE ON HOMOPHONES:
⟦{立替|たてか}え→立替え：10197_tatekae⟧ (also read たてかえ) means advancing money on someone's behalf — a completely different word. Context usually makes the distinction clear.
